statement: Today is Tuesday. What day of the week will it be in 100 days?

choices.misconception: I divided 100 by 7 and moved back by the remainder instead of forward.
I assumed 100 days was a whole number of weeks, so the day would not change.
I used a remainder of 3 because I divided 100 by 7 and rounded rather than taking the remainder.
I counted 100 as fourteen weeks and two days but started counting from Saturday.

hints: Only the remainder after dividing by seven matters.
Days of the week repeat every 7, so split the 100 days into whole weeks plus a remainder and move forward by the remainder alone.
100 = 14 x 7 + 2, so move forward two days from Tuesday.

solutions.reliable: Weeks repeat every 7 days and 100 = 14 x 7 + 2, so the whole weeks change nothing and only the 2 extra days count. Two days after Tuesday is Thursday. The transferable idea: anything that repeats with period n is governed entirely by the remainder on division by n.
solutions.elegant: 98 is a whole number of weeks, so the question is simply two days after Tuesday.

whyOnTest: Cycle questions reduce to a remainder, and the common slips are counting backwards or losing the direction of travel.
author: Devansh Sanghavi
